answer: Require each agent to register with one prism credential binding one identity key to 300 tokens locked 60 days, 100% slashed if a second identity is proven from the same credential. Splitting the credential across clones slashes every tied identity, so copying a fake loses the whole bond. A mirror registry lists each credential once, so a duplicate is visible to auditors in seconds. A glacier audit queue re-checks new identities during the lock, so hiding a clone only delays its slash. Each fake costs 300 tokens for 60 days; 1,000 cost 300,000 tokens, with no bulk discount.
